components.name: CardFolder
components.doc: A folder of index cards: picking a tab pulls that card up out of the pile and drops it in front, while the others settle behind it.

components.name: CardFolderPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: the sample project folder on a quiet stage.

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id, used as the value.

members.name: content
members.doc: What the card shows when it is in front.

members.name: cards
members.doc: The cards, in tab order. Defaults to a sample project folder.

members.name: value
members.doc: Id of the card in front. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control it.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Id of the card that starts in front when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first card.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the card whose tab was picked.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of a card body in px. Every card shares it, so the folder never changes size.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the tab list.
